```lean
:= by
  have h_inj : InjOn f s := by intro x y; rw [hf, hf]; funext; apply Function.injective_iff; exact Eq.refl
  have h_maps_to : MapsTo f s s := by intro x hx; exact ⟨f x, by simp [hf]⟩
  have h_bij : BijectiveOn f s := by refine ⟨h_inj, h_maps_to⟩
  have h_image_image : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
    rw [image_image]
    apply congr
    apply funext
    intro x
    cases x with x hx
    rw [image_eq]
    apply iff.intro
    · intro h
      rcases h with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      exact hz
    · intro h
      rcases h with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨f y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact h_image_image
```
